title: When Scores Conflict with Preferences: Pre-Alignment Diagnosis and Adaptive Correction of Constraint Drift in DPO
abstract: arXiv:2611.07375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is increasingly used in settings where pairwise preferences coexist with pointwise criteria such as response length, answer correctness, or safety scores. When the two disagree, standard DPO treats pairs whose preferred output scores worse on the pointwise criterion (conflict pairs) in the same way as the remaining (matching) pairs. We characterize a systematic failure mode, constraint drift: for sufficiently small updates, conflict pairs tend to increase constraint cost while matching pairs tend to repair it, and the net change depends on their balance. This balance yields a closed-form pre-alignment diagnostic, $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$, computable from dataset statistics, that indicates whether a dataset is self-correcting or requires intervention. Building on this diagnostic, we propose Conflict-aware DPO (CoDPO), which down-weights conflict pairs with a strength set from $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$ r

translated_title: 当分数与偏好冲突时：DPO中约束漂移的对齐前诊断与自适应校正
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）越来越多地应用于成对偏好与逐点标准（如回答长度、答案正确性或安全分数）共存的场景。当两者不一致时，标准DPO会将那些偏好输出在逐点标准上得分更差的样本对（冲突对）与其余（匹配）样本对以相同的方式处理。我们刻画了一种系统性失效模式——约束漂移：对于足够小的更新，冲突对倾向于增加约束成本，而匹配对倾向于修复该成本，净变化取决于两者的平衡。这一平衡产生了一个闭式解的对齐前诊断指标 $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$，可直接从数据集统计量中计算得出，用于指示该数据集是可自我修复的还是需要干预。基于该诊断指标，我们提出了冲突感知DPO（CoDPO），它以由 $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$ 设定的强度对冲突对进行降权……
tldr: 该论文揭示了DPO训练中的系统性失效模式“约束漂移”，提出可从数据集统计量直接计算的闭式对齐前诊断指标 $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$，并据此构建冲突感知DPO（CoDPO），通过自适应降低冲突样本对的权重来校正约束漂移。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "constraint drift" as a systematic failure mode in DPO, introduces a closed-form pre-alignment diagnostic $\rho^{*}_{\mathrm{eq}}$ computable from dataset statistics, and proposes Conflict-aware DPO (CoDPO), which adaptively down-weights conflict pairs to correct constraint drift.
